title: Fully Known by God
story:
A man once tried to surprise his close friend for his birthday.

He planned everything carefully.

He thought he had kept it completely secret.

But later he found out that his friend already knew parts of the plan.

The friend smiled and said,

“You forget how well I know you.”

In life, we often feel unseen or misunderstood.

We think no one really knows what we are going through.

Our thoughts.

Our struggles.

Our hidden worries.

But God knows everything about us completely.

He understands us even better than we understand ourselves.

Nothing about our lives is hidden from Him.

And yet, He still loves us deeply.
life_lesson: You are fully known and deeply loved by God.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for knowing me completely.

Even when I feel misunderstood, remind me that You see and understand me.

Help me to rest in Your perfect knowledge and love.

Draw me closer to You each day.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you ever feel misunderstood by others?

How does it change you to know God fully knows you?

What burden can you surrender to Him today?
